office_does: A Metropolitan King County Councilmember makes county law and adopts the county budget.
race_blurb: Incumbent Jorge L. Barón, first elected in 2023, is unopposed.

candidates.summary: Incumbent District 4 councilmember since January 2024 and former Executive Director of the Northwest Immigrant Rights Project (2008-2023).
highlights: Pamphlet priorities: fair and effective legal systems, homelessness response, public health clinics and Harborview, and Metro safety and reliability [S1]
Says state and local leaders should be uncompromising in defending immigrant and transgender neighbors against the federal administration [S1]
Endorsed by Governor Ferguson, Attorney General Brown, Rep. Jayapal, Executive Zahilay and the King County Democrats [S1]
